entities.name: Vladimír Skalička
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimír Skalička was a Czechoslovak professor, linguist, translator, and polyglot. A member of the influential Prague School of linguists and literary critics and a corresponding member of the Czechoslovak Academy of Sciences, he is credited with further developing morphological typology.
